pages.title: Boltzmann Brains & Poincaré Recurrence
pages.text: $(thing)Boltzmann Brains & Poincaré Recurrence$()$(br2)A dead universe is not quite dead. In a finite system at equilibrium every state comes back, given time, and fluctuations out of equilibrium happen by pure chance - a star, a planet, a brain. Unlocks the Boltzmann Fluctuation.
